description: Performance budgets for bundle size enforcement. Caps are set from the 2026-09-26 measured build (post PurgeCSS rewrite, locale chunk split, assetsInlineLimit: 0) plus ~7-10% headroom. Revised 2026-09-30 after WU-1 (react-router 8.4.0) and again after WU-2 (RTK 2.13 + react-redux 9, total only): fresh measured builds with human approval (PR #146 / stacked WU-2 PR).

default.description: Default chunk size limit (97kb raw, 30kb gzip). Measured: i18n 54652 raw / 18278 gzip.

vendor.description: Vendor chunk limit (288kb raw, 97kb gzip). Measured WU-2 (2026-09-30): vendor 289067 raw (react-redux landed here); WU-1 was 287121 raw / 91660 gzip (react-router 8.4.0; baseline dev 195288 raw / 62130 gzip).

main.description: Main chunk limit (156kb raw, 58kb gzip). Measured: index 142147 raw / 51497 gzip. Tightened below the pre-inline-removal level so re-inlining assets is caught.

total.description: Total JS bundle size limit (498kb raw, 170kb gzip). Measured WU-2 (2026-09-30): 500880 raw (RTK 2.13 + react-redux 9: immer in main, react-redux in vendor), raised from 485000 with human approval. WU-1 measurement was 476365 raw / 157620 gzip JS.

assets.description: Individual non-JS asset limit (120kb). Measured: index CSS 120694 (sdd-134-css, post C1-C5).
